Nina Patel: Quick org note 1: new interim lead for model-onboarding while we hire a PM. Ronan will step in for ~4 months.
Diego Morales: Thanks Nina. I'll coordinate knowledge transfer with Ronan this week. Ronan, can you take the onboarding backlog and the mentorship duty?
Ronan Blake: Yep. I'll take the backlog and schedule 1:1s with each mentor. Planning a 30-min kick-off Thu.
Nina Patel: Recruiting update: hiring team expects to shortlist full-time PMs in 3 weeks. We'll look for someone with infra + evals experience.
Diego Morales: Small ask: can someone send the current model-onboarding checklist repo link? I want Ronan to have it before Thu.
Ronan Blake: link: https://git.internal/redwood/model-onboard-checklist. Also I'll drop a PR with the handoff notes by EOD.
jen-bot: Reminder: please submit equipment request for interim hires within 24h to avoid delays. :package:
Nina Patel: Appreciate the quick responses. We'll treat this as temporary rotation; any policy changes go through RFC and senior PM sign-off. Calendar invite for kick-off sent. :calendar:
